items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible sections whose panels animate to their measured height.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A status message with a glyph picked from its status, a title, a description and an optional action.

items.name: animated-badge
items.title: AnimatedBadge
items.description: A status pill that rolls its content and springs its width when the status changes.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file, image or recording chip with a thumbnail, size, upload progress and remove control.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person as a picture, with an initials fallback, a corner badge and an overlapping group.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label for status or a count, composed from parts like the button.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A draggable sheet over the screen: snap points, keyboard, sticky footer, scrollables, steps and a teleported portal, on @delacour/react-native-bottom-sheet.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current screen: links back up each level, the current page last, with automatic separators, a collapsing middle or a scrolling trail.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A pressable action composed from parts, with variants, sizes and a loading state.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day, several days or a range, with swipe paging and month and year jump views.

items.name: calm-motion
items.title: calmMotion
items.description: Whether decorative loops hold still: reduce motion, or an app's E2E build asking.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A content surface with a header, a body and a footer, built on Surface.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Swipeable slides on one fractional position, with peek, loop, vertical and coverflow layouts, dots and arrows.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Skia charts on the theme's series ramp: line, area, bar, scatter, candlestick and pie, with grid, axes, legend and tooltip.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with an indeterminate state, and a group that owns the selection.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: An interactive pill: a filter that toggles, a tag, or a token with a remove control.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Text set around a circle on an SVG path, optionally turning, with content in the middle.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Class merging that understands the library's semantic size tokens.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section shown and hidden by its own trigger, animated to its measured height.

items.name: color
items.title: isLiteralColor
items.description: Tells a literal colour from a theme token name.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A colour picked by dragging a saturation and brightness area and a hue track, with optional opacity, a hex field and swatches, inline or in a bottom sheet.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A long or remote list behind a field-shaped trigger, filtered as you type in a bottom sheet — chips, server results, custom values.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: Two layers of one frame with a seam you drag across, revealed by a transform rather than a resize.

items.name: compose-refs
items.title: composeRefs
items.description: Merges several refs onto one node.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The actions that belong to a piece of content, reached by holding it — Menu's rows over a scrim, with a lifted preview.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: Time left until a fixed moment, read from the wall clock every tick — sliding segmented digits or an inline run.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A centred card over a dimmed app that asks for a decision or a short input: confirm, alert dialog, form, with keyboard lift and focus handling.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets LTR or RTL for a subtree and exposes the sign for gesture maths.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and covers the app until dismissed: a navigation menu, a filter panel, a notifications tray, with swipe-to-dismiss and RTL-aware sides.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A placeholder for a list or screen with nothing in it: media, title, description and actions.

items.name: expo
items.title: Navigation theme
items.description: Hands expo-router's navigator this library's colours, including the slab behind a push.

items.name: fab
items.title: Fab
items.description: A floating action button, extended with a label or unfolding a dial of related actions.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: A dialog for writing: the field in a recessed well, a send that waits on a promise, a draft kept across close, and steps that ease between heights.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One control with its label, description and error — and the state they all read.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: FlipCard
items.description: Two faces of one card and a turn between them, by tap, swipe or code.

items.name: flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: A pan-and-zoom canvas of nodes joined by self-routing edges, with groups, handle-to-handle connections, controls and a minimap — the app owns the graph.

items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: A titled shell around a card of divided rows, with sections and a footer.

items.name: grid-item
items.title: Grid Item
items.description: A bento grid of whole-cell tiles with aligned edges, and the tile with title, value and background parts.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A Central Icons glyph that inherits size and colour from the surrounding component.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The Central Icons set, re-exported so components import glyphs from one place.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field, with a group that puts prefixes, suffixes, buttons and full-width blocks inside its border.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, text and actions for lists and settings, standalone or as a List Group row.

items.name: keyboard-animation
items.title: keyboardAnimation
items.description: The timing the keyboard opens with, so content moving with it stays in step.

items.name: kpi
items.title: Kpi
items.description: One number, its change coloured by what it means, and a sparkline of how it got there, built on Card.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form control's name, with required, invalid and disabled states.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: Ranked people or teams with ties, the top three on a podium of growing bars or lifted cards, and the highlighted entry pinned below the cut.

items.name: list-group
items.title: List Group
items.description: A surface grouping related rows, with dividers inserted automatically.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: A themed MapLibre map on a token-painted basemap: markers, pins, labels, popups, routes, arcs and controls, with a camera ref.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown Editor
items.description: A Markdown field with a formatting toolbar, a monospaced write pane and a rendered preview.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A centred inline note for a step or a day break between conversation turns, static or pressable.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content that travels across its container on a loop, held still on touch.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions anchored to the control that opens it — checkbox and radio rows, in-place submenus.

items.name: merge-props
items.title: mergeProps
items.description: Merges slot props onto a child's own.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A chat bubble with direction, run-aware corners, delivery status, reactions and an avatar gutter.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A bottom-anchored conversation list: sticks to the newest message, jumps to latest with an unread count, loads older history, rises with the keyboard.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement on a fixed scale, coloured by where it falls — by regions, thresholds or whole blocks.

items.name: navigation-theme
items.title: navigationTheme
items.description: Maps the theme's tokens onto the colours React Navigation asks for.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A number between a minus and a plus: tap to step, hold to repeat, or type and commit on blur.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code or PIN: cells drawn over one hidden field, with autofill and paste.

items.name: overlay
items.title: Overlay
items.description: The provider, teleported portal, scrim, presence lifecycle and back-button handling every dialog, drawer, popover, tooltip and toast is drawn with.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: A cover, an overlapping avatar, a title block, actions and stats — the head of a profile or place screen.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through pages of a result set: a fixed-width run of numbers and gaps, a compact readout, or labelled arrows.

items.name: paging
items.title: paging
items.description: Worklet-safe maths of paging through slides on one fractional position.

items.name: planner
items.title: Planner
items.description: A month of days, each showing what falls on it — category dots, icons, tiles or named blocks — with swipe paging, a week scroller and a sheet of the selected day.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel anchored to its trigger that flips and shifts to stay on screen, with an arrow, a title, a close control and an optional scrim.

items.name: post
items.title: Post
items.description: A social card: author, body, media and animated counts, in four shapes.

items.name: pressable
items.title: Pressable
items.description: The Gesture API press primitive: scale and fade feedback, haptics, disabled and busy states.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar showing how far a task has got, or a looping segment while it is under way.

items.name: progress-button
items.title: Progress Button
items.description: A button held to confirm: a fill grows while it is held and the action fires when it reaches the end.

items.name: provider
items.title: Provider
items.description: The root provider: safe-area insets seeded from the launch snapshot, and gesture handling.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QRCode
items.description: A string a camera can read, drawn as one vector path, with an optional centre logo.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A guided form, one question at a time: single and multiple choice, text, rating, scale and yes/no, with branching, skips, validation and progress.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A radio and the group that owns which one is selected.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A row of stars that reads or sets a score, by tap or by drag, in whole or half steps.

items.name: screen
items.title: Screen
items.description: A screen frame: pinned chrome, a content region, and whatever scrolls between them.

items.name: scroll-edges
items.title: scrollEdges
items.description: Where an affordance at a scrollable's edges sits, and which way its gradient runs.

items.name: scroll-maths
items.title: scrollMaths
items.description: The pure maths behind the scroll-linked components.

items.name: scroll-sections
items.title: scrollSections
items.description: Which section a scroll offset is in, and how far down the content it is.

items.name: scroll-text
items.title: ScrollText
items.description: Text that resolves word by word as the screen scrolls past it.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: The query field at the top of a list: clear, Cancel, debounced reporting and filter tokens.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A closed set of choices behind a field-shaped trigger, picked from a bottom sheet — single or multiple, grouped, searchable.

items.name: selection-mode
items.title: Selection Mode
items.description: Pick several things at once — a long press enters the mode — then act on them from a bar, in a list, a grid or a strip.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule, hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: signature
items.title: Signature
items.description: A pad to sign with a finger, with undo, redo and clear, handing back the strokes as JSON or SVG.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder that shimmers or pulses while content loads, in step across a group.

items.name: sketch
items.title: Sketch
items.description: A finger-drawing surface with a pen, eight shapes, an eraser, colours, stroke width and undo, drawn with Skia and exported as SVG or PNG.

items.name: slide-button
items.title: Slide Button
items.description: A handle dragged across a rail to confirm an action a tap should not reach.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value along a track, dragged by a handle that follows the gesture.

items.name: slot
items.title: Slot
items.description: Renders into a child element instead of a wrapper.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated loading indicator drawn on the icon scale.

items.name: split-view
items.title: SplitView
items.description: Two stacked panes with a grip that settles on named heights.

items.name: splitter
items.title: Splitter
items.description: Two or more panes divided by draggable handles, sized in percent.

items.name: stack-card
items.title: Stack Card
items.description: A deck taken one card at a time by throwing the top one off, with stamps, undo and a decline.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A stepper for multi-step flows: completed, current and upcoming steps joined by a line.

items.name: styles
items.title: Styles
items.description: Tailwind base, the semantic size tokens, and the light and dark theme palettes.

items.name: support
items.title: Support
items.description: A help section: availability, channels, topics, past requests and the furniture around a support thread.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: A rounded container on the theme's fill ladder, stepping to the next fill as it nests.

items.name: swipe
items.title: Swipe
items.description: A row that slides aside to reveal actions behind it, with a full swipe and a group that keeps one open.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off control whose thumb can be dragged as well as tapped.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of short values lined up by one set of column rules, with sortable heads, selectable rows, a horizontal scroll for wide tables and a card frame.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A swipeable pager with an indicator measured against the active tab.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Free-form tags typed into one field box, each a removable chip, with validation and a max.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Typography: the type scale, weights and the page-level colours.

items.name: text-animation
items.title: TextAnimation
items.description: Five ways a piece of text or a number arrives — reveal, typing, rotating, counting, rolling.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline text field sized in rows, with auto-grow and a character count.

items.name: theme-selector
items.title: Theme Selector
items.description: System, Light or Dark, read from the live Uniwind theme and applied to it, with no storage dependency.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A time of day on snapping wheels — hour, minute, optional second and AM/PM — in a bottom sheet or inline.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Dated events down a rail or across a swipeable strip: progress fills the rail, tone tints the marker, and a list virtualises long histories.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message shown from anywhere, even outside React: stacked at an edge, swiped away, paused while touched, with a promise form and Alert's statuses.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a group with single or multiple selection.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on a long press, anchored to its control: hides itself, lets an outside tap through, and reads to a screen reader on the trigger.

items.name: tv
items.title: tv
items.description: tailwind-variants, taught the library's semantic size tokens.

items.name: use-calm-motion
items.title: useCalmMotion
items.description: Whether decorative loops hold still, and the provider an E2E build sets it from.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: State that works controlled or uncontrolled from the same prop pair.

items.name: use-keyboard-state-sync
items.title: useKeyboardStateSync
items.description: Keeps the keyboard's height and progress on the UI thread, for layout that tracks it.

items.name: use-navigation-theme
items.title: useNavigationTheme
items.description: Resolves the theme's colours for the active scheme, ready for a navigator.

items.name: use-scroll-sections
items.title: useScrollSections
items.description: Tracks the section a scroll view is showing and its progress, on the UI thread.

items.name: use-scroll-source
items.title: useScrollSource
items.description: The scroll offset and sizes of a scrollable, on the UI thread, for effects that follow it.

items.name: use-theme-color
items.title: useThemeColor
items.description: Resolves a theme token to the colour the active scheme gives it.
